name: Kommando

bonuses.name: Speed
bonuses.text: Speed is printed as "5 (May not Run or Sprint)".

abilities.name: Sneaky Gitz
abilities.text: During the first round of combat in which a Kommando ambushes their opponent, they may use their Stealth dice pool of 8 for any Test.

options.name: MORE DAKKA!
options.text: For every ten Kommandos in the Mob, one may have one of the following options (while keeping their Choppa and Slugga):

mobAbilities.name: Mob Rule
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Kommandos gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Kommandos.

mobAbilities.name: Kunnin' Infiltraters
mobAbilities.text: When a Mob of Kommandos makes a Stealth (A) Test, add +1 Icon to the result.

note: Print oddity, copied as printed: TA p.89 gives this Kommando Threat A|A|A|A|A, Conviction 6, Resolve 5, Speed 5 (May not Run or Sprint) and Size Lrg, yet it has Mob options and Mob Rule. Those look copied from another block; the Core p.355 Kommando prints E E T T, Conviction 2, Resolve 1, Speed 6, Avg, and a table that wants the Core block fields that one (rules-flow.md §11.120).
